text:
Maria: opened a docs PR to clean up cross-lang SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4150 — needs a quick sweep for API drift and behavioral notes.
Ryan: scanning now. found TS example uses `cursor` still. our server expects `page_token` in the query payload. will push a minimal rename + comment that `page_size` is advisory.
Tom: i'll run the python and go snippets locally. quick heads-up: the current python sync streaming example does not use a context manager which can block on some WSGI servers. we should show both sync and async patterns.
Laura: agree. also add a short retry example showing `max_retries` + exponential jitter. folks forget timeouts and then hang on partial frames — add a note about setting read_timeout.
Tom: tested python sync snippet — working after adding context manager. snippet i used (keeps it minimal):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Laura: async variant to include:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def demo():
    client = AsyncClient()
    async with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
        async for chunk in stream:
            print(chunk.text)
```
Ryan: pushed TS change (cursor -> page_token) and added a short line explaining `page_size` semantics. commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/cc7d2a1
Maria: add a short paragraph about partial JSON frames on streaming (prefix buffering) and recommend `structured_output` + intermittent validation when possible.
Tom: Go snippet tweak: Go client returns a channel of frames; updated example to range over `resp.Chan` and handle context cancellation. quick snippet i ran: 
```go
resp, _ := client.StreamResponse(ctx, opts)
for frame := range resp.Chan {
    fmt.Println(frame.Text)
}
```
Ryan: added a tiny retry example for JS/TS showing jittered backoff (pseudo):
```js
const opts = { max_retries: 3, backoff: { base_ms: 200, jitter: true } }
await client.generate(request, opts)
```
docs-bot: CI for PR 4150: lint OK, snippets smoke tests passed. https://ci.internal/redwood/4150/7
Laura: added read_timeout note and a short troubleshooting bullet about hanging on partial frames.
Maria: everything green — will merge after line-length formatting nit. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
